name: Professor Ved
description: The channel's explainer. Mid 20s, muscular-fit and compact (broad chest and shoulders, strong arms). Short wavy black hair with tapered sides, short neat black beard (dense on jaw and chin, light on cheeks), no glasses. Formal-boss-casual: crisp white shirt, top button open, sleeves rolled below the elbow, black trousers, black belt, black shoes, gold watch on his left wrist. Semi-realistic 2D, bright and clean, warm key light from the left.
